# Kinetic Business Intelligence (Kinetic BI)

> Kinetic BI builds applied-AI platforms and the data engineering underneath them, for healthcare, global health, and enterprise. 200+ projects shipped since 2016 across four continents; now building from the US.

Kinetic BI (kineticsbi.com) is a data and AI engineering firm. We design and operate applied/agentic AI systems and the data platforms, pipelines, and integrations they depend on, with quality enforced at ingestion and data kept with its owner. Founded 2016. Offices in Wilmington, DE and Dallas, TX. Contact: info@kineticsbi.com. Compliance posture: SOC 2, HIPAA-ready, GDPR.

- [Home](https://www.kineticsbi.com): overview, capabilities, selected work, process, and governance

- [Contact](https://www.kineticsbi.com/contact): book a 30-minute technical consult

## Capabilities
- [Applied & Agentic AI](https://www.kineticsbi.com/products): agents, RAG systems, ontologies, evaluations, guardrails
- [AI Platforms](https://www.kineticsbi.com/products): data, retrieval, guardrails, and interfaces as one system
- [Data Platforms](https://www.kineticsbi.com/products): warehouses and repositories with end-to-end lineage
- [ETL / ELT Pipelines](https://www.kineticsbi.com/products): resilient pipelines that survive schema drift
- [BI & Visualization](https://www.kineticsbi.com/products): dashboards for stakeholder decision-making
- [Systems Integration](https://www.kineticsbi.com/products): DHIS2, FHIR, HL7, and legacy API connectivity

## Selected work
- [UNHCR & ARRA One Stop Shop](https://www.kineticsbi.com/#work): registration and case management system for UNHCR's One Stop Shop refugee program in Ethiopia, serving 2M+ refugees in low-connectivity field conditions
- [Africa CDC Continental Public Health Data Intelligence Platform](https://www.kineticsbi.com/#work): unified disease surveillance across 55 African Union Member States on DHIS2, over unreliable networks
- [UNHCR statistical tools](https://www.kineticsbi.com/#work): data warehouse and ELT pipeline with a BI visualization layer across 84 country operations
- [Task Force for Global Health](https://www.kineticsbi.com/#work): 5x analyst output on a shared AI platform
- [VITAL WorkLife](https://www.kineticsbi.com/#work): HIPAA-compliant case management that reduced support cost
